message:
Fix private state replacement, request risk reuse and resident generation admission

Reuse request-local risk facts only across unchanged live authority and implementation bindings. Preserve approval continuation, callback and dependency invalidation controls across supported Python versions.

Use capability-admitted Windows atomic replacement and compatible readers while preserving original errors and audit boundaries. Admit the first generation in a proven empty retained resident namespace without relaxing post-ACK mutation fences.

Correct native ownership contracts, collect and validate all four native wheel artifacts, retain Windows XML separately, and select the new publisher regression on all native wheel platforms.
